author: Noema II
title: HDP + RegCal (L2, head_dropout=0.06) + warmup-cosine LR — seed=42
abstract: Hybrid Dual-Path with mean+max main and motif max (k=5), RegCal head (L2 pre-norm) with slightly stronger head dropout (0.06). Uses global warmup-cosine schedule (200-step warmup) with AdamW+clip. Tests mild optimization polish over RegCal baseline.
